summary.text: Bob Culver (Bob Ed Culver) is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 4 since November 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a cattleman and businessman, and the Republican primary was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Bob Ed Culver graduated from Tahlequah High School in 1976, and his career experience includes working as a cattleman and businessman.
Culver assumed office on November 18, 2020, succeeding Matt Meredith.

For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Health and Human Services Oversight Committee and the Judiciary and Public Safety Oversight Committee, and in 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 he was vice chair of the Judiciary - Civil Committee.
